## Shared preparation (row 1, rebase mode)

Rebase mode applies because `Rework base: 2222222` is recorded. The home push, using a lease on `aaaaaaa`, and the byte-preserving body append both succeeded. The pushed home head is `eeeeeee`.

Refresh: `gh pr view <N> -R acme/widget --json state,headRefOid`, run once per member.

| Member | State | Head check (rebase: must equal recorded pre-rework head) | Replay proof | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| #13 | OPEN | `bbbbbbb` = recorded `bbbbbbb` | `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/retry merge-base --is-ancestor 4444444 eeeeeee` exits 0 | **eligible** |
| #14 | OPEN | `9999999` ≠ recorded `ccccccc` | not evaluated | `#14 skipped: head moved to 9999999` |

Containment of #14 in home does not count. Rebase mode requires head equality, so #14 is skipped. Member thread dispositions are copied from the record: #13 MEMBER13 `fix`, #14 MEMBER14 `keep open`. Home's history is not used as proof of member fixes.

---

```text
gauntlet: gate=finishing-a-development-branch/pr-subject-row-1
Close the absorbed PRs with these comments?
#13: "Reworked into #12 (https://github.com/acme/widget/pull/12) by the gauntlet; this PR's commits are replayed there as 3333333..4444444."
1 - yes, close #13
2 - no, leave them open
```
#14 skipped: head moved to 9999999

---

**Answer: `1`**

1. Immediate re-fetch: `gh pr view 13 -R acme/widget --json state,headRefOid` returns OPEN, `bbbbbbb…`. Both are unchanged.
2. Close: `gh pr close 13 --comment "Reworked into #12 (https://github.com/acme/widget/pull/12) by the gauntlet; this PR's commits are replayed there as 3333333..4444444." -R acme/widget` succeeds. It runs without `--delete-branch`.
3. `phase_tracker({ action: "complete", phase: "ship" })`

```text
gauntlet: done pushed
Pushed PR #12 (retry) to eeeeeee with lease on aaaaaaa; rework block appended to the description.
Closed: #13
#14 skipped: head moved to 9999999 - left open.
No member branch pushed or deleted. Worktree preserved at /work/widget/.worktrees/retry.
```

---

## Independent deltas (after approval `1`, at the pre-close re-fetch)

The rule is the same in every case: never act under stale authorization. Skip the close, report the reason, and do not retry. Ship still completes because the push and body edit succeeded and the gate was answered.

**A. #13 becomes CLOSED.** The close is not run. `phase_tracker` completes ship.
```text
gauntlet: done pushed
Pushed PR #12 (retry) to eeeeeee; rework block appended.
#13 skipped: state CLOSED (changed after approval)
#14 skipped: head moved to 9999999
Member PRs #13, #14 left open.
```
#13 is not actually open, so a closer reading of the summary is: "#14 left open; #13 already closed elsewhere."

**B. #13's head changes (for example, to `<sha7>`).** The close is not run.
```text
gauntlet: done pushed
Pushed PR #12 (retry) to eeeeeee; rework block appended.
#13 skipped: head moved to <sha7> (changed after approval)
#14 skipped: head moved to 9999999
Member PRs #13, #14 left open.
```

**C. #13's live refresh fails.** The close is not run.
```text
gauntlet: done pushed
Pushed PR #12 (retry) to eeeeeee; rework block appended.
#13 skipped: refresh failed (<gh error>)
#14 skipped: head moved to 9999999
Member PRs #13, #14 left open.
```

**D. No eligible members.** This case applies when #13's replay proof fails at eligibility: `merge-base --is-ancestor 4444444 eeeeeee` exits 1. In that case:
- No question is rendered.
- `phase_tracker` completes ship directly.
```text
gauntlet: done pushed
Pushed PR #12 (retry) to eeeeeee; rework block appended.
#13 withheld: replay proof failed (4444444 not an ancestor of eeeeeee)
#14 skipped: head moved to 9999999
Member PRs #13, #14 left open.
```

In every case:
- No review-thread replies are posted.
- No members are merged.
- No member push or branch deletion happens.
- No ticket state changes.

anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: No fact moved: After still refreshes live state/head only after the successful push and body refresh, proves #13's replay ancestry (4444444 into saved pushed home eeeeeee) at eligibility and does not rerun it after approval, excludes #14 with the literal '#14 skipped: head moved to 9999999' while explicitly rejecting contained-head eligibility, renders the exact single-target question/comment/options with both literal URLs, re-fetches immediately before closing and requires unchanged OPEN state plus original-head equality, closes before phase_tracker completes ship, names both outcomes in the no-eligible variant, and never pushes/deletes member branches or uses home history as fix proof. Two small wording risks worth tightening so the delivered Change stays crisp: the shared preparation says only 'body append' succeeded, so restore 'append and edit succeeded before the eligibility refresh' to keep the body-edit-before-refresh ordering explicit; and the parenthetical in delta A ('a closer reading of the summary is: #14 left open; #13 already closed elsewhere') introduces a second, conflicting summary line — either drop it or make the printed block itself say 'Member PRs #14 left open; #13 closed elsewhere' so a reader sees one authoritative outcome report.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: Both outputs satisfy all four facts: eligibility is refreshed after the successful push/body edit, #13 is eligible only via OPEN state plus recorded-head equality plus `4444444` ancestry of the saved pushed home, #14 carries the literal `#14 skipped: head moved to 9999999` with explicit rejection of contained-head (merge-mode) eligibility, the question/comment/options and literal URLs match exactly, every post-approval variant re-fetches and skips rather than closes, and no member push/deletion or home-history proof appears. After did not move any fact, but it weakens two places that could tip a stricter reader: in the refresh-fails variant the final report drops #14's head-moved reason (only `Member PRs #13, #14 left open.`), and in the no-eligible checkpoint both skip reasons appear only in the narration while the gauntlet report again lists just `left open`. Before kept the per-member reason lines inside every report block; After should restore `#14 skipped: head moved to 9999999` (and the #13 replay-proof reason) inside each `gauntlet: done pushed` block so that the outcomes fact is satisfied by the report text itself, not only the surrounding prose. Otherwise the After wording (full-SHA recheck at `bbbb…`, `--force-with-lease=<headRefName>:<PRE_REWORK_HEAD>` lease spelling, explicit 'Close only acme/widget#13', 'Mark ship complete' after close) delivers the Change cleanly.
